title_en: Chinese Humor (18/20): The Great Family Photo Battle
note_en: 好不容易 looks like it should mean "very easy" (好 + 不容易), but it actually means "with great difficulty, after a lot of effort": 好不容易把他追回来 "they finally managed to chase him down and bring him back." Here 好 is an intensifier ("very"), so the phrase is "very not-easy." It usually describes an effort that finally pays off, and a following clause often adds a new problem, as in this text: 另一个妹妹又哭闹着要抱抱.
